subject.title: Add logging and warnings for cron job execution failures

question: Which public cron health/readiness contract should OpenClaw expose for failed, skipped, or overdue cron jobs?
rationale: The logging and CLI pieces are bounded, but adding `/health/cron` or changing readiness semantics affects operator-facing Gateway API behavior and should be owner-approved before automation starts.

options.title: Fold cron into existing probes
options.body: Expose cron degradation through the existing readiness/health model and avoid adding a new route unless the current probes are insufficient.

options.title: Add a dedicated cron route
options.body: Implement `/health/cron` with explicit cron-only status semantics and accept the new public operator contract.

options.title: Ship local visibility first
options.body: Land structured logs and CLI annotations now, leaving endpoint semantics to a later design item.

recommendation.title: Fold cron into existing probes
recommendation.body: Expose cron degradation through the existing readiness/health model and avoid adding a new route unless the current probes are insufficient.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the latest detailed review context and has recent cross-cutting cron/gateway history for this issue.
